title: RBI Issues Digital Payment Security Controls Directions, 2026 for Credit-Card Issuing NBFCs
description: RBI issued Digital Payment Security Controls Directions, 2026 for credit-card issuing NBFCs, prescribing governance, cybersecurity, authentication and customer protection norms.The post RBI Issues Digital Payment Security Controls Directions, 2026 for Credit-Card Issuing NBFCs appeared first on TaxGuru.
